scripts.test:mac: bazel test //apple/... && xcodebuild -project apple/AxoMac/AxoMac.xcodeproj -scheme Axo -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.test: npm --prefix packages/axo-api run test && npm --prefix sites/axo.leostera.dev test && npm run test:pi-control && npm run test:pi-discovery
scripts.test:pi-interactive: cargo build --manifest-path axod/Cargo.toml --locked --offline --example interactive-pi-fixture && tsc -p pi-axo/tsconfig.json && tsc -p axod/pi/tsconfig.json && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 axod/tests/pi/interactive.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix packages/axo-api run build && npm --prefix sites/axo.leostera.dev run typecheck && tsc -p pi-axo/tsconfig.json && tsc -p axod/pi/tsconfig.json
